paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: The donut chart illustrates the win rates (%) of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—in a comparison of empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. The chart is divided into four segments, each representing a model’s performance: Mistral leads with 88.0%, shown in a light beige color; LLaMA follows with 80.4%, depicted in a light blue; GPT-4o has two distinct segments: one labeled 19.6% in a medium blue and another labeled 12.0% in a dark red, possibly indicating different evaluation conditions or versions. The chart includes a central white circle with the label “Win rate (%)”, and each segment is connected to its corresponding label via a black line. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with Mistral’s segment being the largest and visually prominent. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels and percentages are clearly marked next to each segment.
